rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year1:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET  @b_year:=(SELECT IF( YEAR(NOW()) > @b_year1 , @b_year1 , YEAR(NOW()))); 
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year,'0101');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'1231');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_envocc65(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result10 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result11 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result12 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result6 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result7 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result8 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result9 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_envocc65 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF  EXISTS tmpz_envocc;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_envocc(KEY(cid)) ENGINE=myisam as (
		SELECT 	p.check_hosp HOSPCODE ,p.vhid areacode, p.cid,DATE_SERV,DIAGCODE,MONTH(MIN(DATE_SERV)) m
		FROM t_envocc e INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON e.CID=p.CID
		WHERE  SUBSTR(p.vhid,1,2) in(@prov_c)  
			AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) 
			AND (p.DISCHARGE  in(2,3,9) OR (p.DISCHARGE  in(1)  AND p.DDISCHARGE > @start_d))
			AND SUBSTR(e.DIAGCODE,1,3)  BETWEEN  'I20' AND 'I25' AND flag_y97 IN(1)
			AND DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
		GROUP BY CID
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_envocc65
(
SELECT
	 @id,t.hospcode,t.areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year
    ,SUM(t.result04+t.result1014+t.result1559+t.result59+t.result60) as target
		,SUM(r.result10+r.result11+r.result12+r.result1+r.result2+r.result3+r.result4+ r.result5+r.result6+r.result7+r.result8+r.result9) 
		,SUM(r.result10),SUM(r.result11),SUM(r.result12),SUM(r.result1),SUM(r.result2),SUM(r.result3),SUM(r.result4) 
    ,SUM(r.result5),SUM(r.result6),SUM(r.result7),SUM(r.result8),SUM(r.result9) 
FROM
 t_person_envocc  t
LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT e.hospcode,e.areacode
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(10) , e.CID,NULL )) result10
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(11) , e.CID,NULL )) result11
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(12) , e.CID,NULL )) result12
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(1) , e.CID,NULL )) result1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(2), e.CID,NULL )) result2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(3), e.CID,NULL )) result3
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(4), e.CID,NULL )) result4
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(5), e.CID,NULL )) result5
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(6), e.CID,NULL )) result6
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(7), e.CID,NULL )) result7
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(8), e.CID,NULL )) result8
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(e.m in(9), e.CID,NULL )) result9
FROM tmpz_envocc e 
GROUP BY e.hospcode,e.areacode
) r ON t.hospcode=r.hospcode AND t.areacode=r.areacode
GROUP BY t.hospcode,t.areacode
);
rows.aname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบป่วยโรคหัวใจขาดเลือด (ICD-10 TM CODE  I20-I25)
rows.bname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบ จากแฟ้ม Person ตามมาตรฐานโครงสร้าง 43 แฟ้ม (สถานะการอยู่อาศัย Typearea = 1, 3)
rows.notice:
ประชากรสัญชาติไทยในเขตรับผิดชอบ จากประชากรแฟ้ม PERSON
- TYPEAREA 1,3
- NATION = 099
- DISCHARGE 2,3,9 หาก DISCHARGE =1 DDISCHARGE ต้องมากกว่าวันที่ 1 ตุลาคมของปีงบประมาณที่คำนวน

ป่วยโรคหัวใจขาดเลือด นับจากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD และ DIAGNOSIS_IPD ตัดความซ้ำซ้อนด้วยเลขบัตรประชาชน
- DIAGCODE เป็น I20-I25 ร่วมกับ Y97

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query:
SELECT ar_code as a_code,ar_name as a_name, SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(result10) as result10 ,SUM(result11) as result11 ,SUM(result12) as result12 ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3 ,SUM(result4) as result4 ,SUM(result5) as result5 ,SUM(result6) as result6 ,SUM(result7) as result7 ,SUM(result8) as result8 ,SUM(result9) as result9  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT z.zonecode as ar_code ,zonename as ar_name,changwatcode as l_code
            FROM cchangwat c INNER JOIN czone z ON c.zonecode=z.zonecode WHERE c.zonecode not in('99') GROUP BY z.zonecode,zonename,l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,2)=ar.l_code LEFT JOIN chospital_regis as h ON s.hospcode=h.hoscode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON s.hospcode = c.hcode AND c.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id='90896cde087b4969e5f7216894288515' and b_year={{YEAR}} and (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY ar_code,ar_name ORDER BY ar_code
